opening: My left eye is extremely sensitive to light.
The vision in my left eye has got worse.
They started three weeks after I finished the week of eye drops for the infection.
My left eye is a little red.
A month ago my left eye suddenly became red and uncomfortable with pus coming out, and four days later my right eye did the same. I was told it was bacterial conjunctivitis in both eyes.
For that infection I used moxifloxacin 0.5%/dexamethasone 0.1% eye drops every 2 hours for one week.
When the pain and vision problems started, I was told my eye pressure was high and that I probably had autoimmune uveitis with high pressure in both eyes.

opening.text: My left eye hurts and is extremely sensitive to light. The vision in my left eye has got worse, and it's a little red. These symptoms started three weeks after I finished the week of eye drops for an infection. A month ago, my left eye suddenly became red and uncomfortable with pus coming out, and four days later my right eye did the same. I was told it was bacterial conjunctivitis in both eyes. For that infection, I used moxifloxacin 0.5%/dexamethasone 0.1% eye drops every 2 hours for one week. When the pain and vision problems started, I was told my eye pressure was high and that I probably had autoimmune uveitis with high pressure in both eyes.
